name: uengage.io/php-platform-sdk
description: PHP SDK for the uEngage platform API (zones, business, audit, auth, events). OAuth2 client_credentials, legacy session exchange, and static-Bearer auth modes with pluggable token caching (APCu / file / in-memory), plus a buffered fail-open publisher for the platform event bus.

suggest.aws/aws-sdk-php: Required only to publish onto the platform event bus ($platform->events). Kept out of require so consumers that never publish are not forced onto the AWS SDK and its PHP >= 7.2.5 floor; EventsClient fails open with an error_log entry when it is absent.
